name: resumefill-agent
description: Local-first resume autofill agent and Windows desktop manager

scripts.test:desktop: npm --prefix desktop test && node desktop/extension-test.cjs && node desktop/auto-pair-browser-test.cjs && node desktop/profile-sync-browser-test.cjs
scripts.test:electron: node desktop/ui-test.cjs && node desktop/pdf-test.cjs && node desktop/auth-ui-test.cjs && node desktop/updater-ui-test.cjs
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run test:browser && npm run test:desktop && npm run test:electron
scripts.release:check: npm run version:check && node scripts/check-release.cjs && npm run privacy && npm run runtime:check
scripts.format:check: prettier --check desktop/controller.cjs desktop/main.cjs popup.js content.js controls.js
